_meta.report: NBA Official Injury Report, 11/14/26 01:30 PM ET edition
_meta.edition_published: YES. The official index lists the 11/14 series from 12:00 AM ET to 01:30 PM ET; 01:30 PM ET is the newest edition on the index at read time.
_meta.supersedes_for_currency: data/raw/s14/injury_report_2026-11-14_0415ET.json (04:15 AM ET) and data/proplogs/2026-11-14/injury_2026-11-14_04_30AM.json (04:30 AM ET). Those files are NOT modified or deleted by this session; this file is the newer edition kept beside them.
_meta.method: The PDF was read twice, independently, and the two reads are byte-identical. The reading method was validated first on the 04:15 AM ET edition: re-reading that PDF reproduced data/raw/s14/injury_report_2026-11-14_0415ET.json row for row, including every NOT YET SUBMITTED stub.
_meta.cell_semantics: An empty player cell with status NOT YET SUBMITTED is the PDF's own stub row for a team that had not filed when this edition was published. It is not a missing value and not a zero.
_meta.page_break_note: The PDF is multi-page and the reader drops the leading columns on pages 2-5. Every row therefore carries read_page and a team_basis cell stating exactly what the attribution rests on. Two blocks needed independent evidence (see team_basis) and are flagged.
_meta.deadline_note: Official rule, quoted from the index page: game-day reports are due between 11 a.m. and 1 p.m. local time (8-10 a.m. for tip-offs at 5 p.m. or earlier), except for the second game of a back-to-back, which is due by 1 p.m. local time on the day of the game. MEM's 8:00 PM ET tip is 7:00 PM CT, so Memphis was still inside its local window when this edition was published at 1:30 PM ET (12:30 PM CT). NOT YET SUBMITTED at that hour is NOT a deadline violation and is not reported as one.

change_vs_0415_edition.reading: Four of the five 11/14 teams that had not filed at 04:15 AM ET filed by 01:30 PM ET (New Orleans, Cleveland, Chicago, Miami). Memphis had not filed and, at 1:30 PM ET, was still inside its local 1 p.m. CT window, so this is not a deadline violation. Inside the teams that had already filed, exactly two player-level designations moved: Brooklyn's Mikel Brown Jr. Questionable to Probable and Detroit's Elijah Harkless and Isaac Jones Questionable to Available (three player rows across two teams). Every other already-filed row is identical between the two editions.
